text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members meet for short standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test ideas early, get feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to change and deliver value faster.
